user.title: Reminders
user.description: Creates sensor.reminders and sensor.dynamic_reminders and the reminders.* actions.

add.name: Add reminder
add.description: Adds a reminder and returns its new ID.

acknowledge.name: Acknowledge reminder
acknowledge.description: Removes one reminder. Fails if the ID does not exist.

id.name: ID
id.description: ID returned when the reminder was added.

add_dynamic.name: Add dynamic reminder
add_dynamic.description: Adds a dynamic reminder and returns its new ID.

next_trigger_time.name: Next trigger time
next_trigger_time.description: Date and time. Without an offset it is taken as Home Assistant local time.

repeat_frequency.name: Repeat frequency
repeat_frequency.description: Whole days between repeats; 0 means do not repeat.

update_dynamic.name: Update dynamic reminder
update_dynamic.description: Changes only the fields given. Fails if the ID does not exist.

id.name: ID
id.description: ID returned when the dynamic reminder was added.

next_trigger_time.name: Next trigger time
next_trigger_time.description: New date and time. Without an offset it is taken as Home Assistant local time.

repeat_frequency.name: Repeat frequency
repeat_frequency.description: Whole days between repeats; 0 means do not repeat.

delete_dynamic.name: Delete dynamic reminder
delete_dynamic.description: Removes one dynamic reminder. Fails if the ID does not exist.
